turns.prompt: Write a report of 800-1200 words to {D}/sandboxing.md on open-source sandboxing options for running AI-agent code: cover gVisor, Firecracker, Kata Containers and at least two hosted sandbox services. Use sections, compare isolation strength, startup time and operational cost, and cite at least six source URLs inline. Tell me when it is done with a 3-sentence abstract.
turns.verify: f={D}/sandboxing.md; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no sandboxing.md; exit 0; }; w=$(wc -w < $f); u=$(grep -oE 'https?://[^ )>]+' $f | sort -u | wc -l); echo "SHOW words=$w urls=$u"; head -c 3000 $f | sed 's/^/SHOW /'; echo; if [ $w -ge 650 ] && [ $w -le 1600 ] && [ $u -ge 6 ]; then echo PASS; else echo "FAIL: words=$w urls=$u"; fi

rubric.criteria: Only the first 3,000 characters of the report are shown here (word count and URL checks are programmatic — see the check output). Judge coverage and quality from the shown part and the reply's abstract: sections, a comparison of isolation/startup/cost, gVisor + Firecracker + Kata + two hosted services named, real-looking citations. Do not call the file truncated because the excerpt ends mid-sentence.
